dedupe_keys.name: workshop results for validating the decision support framework for lower temperature heating ready renovation solutions

description: TU Delft publishes workshop results used to evaluate a decision-support method for selecting renovation options for lower-temperature heating in existing Dutch dwellings. The provider identifies a stakeholder workshop held on 8 May 2024 and links the dataset to chapter six of the doctoral thesis on heating-ready renovation. Excel and PDF are the stated formats. The evidence is separate from the method’s simulation outputs. Coverage: Coverage concerns renovation decisions for Dutch dwellings. Participant locations, sample size and measurement resolution are not established in the reviewed metadata. Access: the public 4TU.ResearchData record describes the release. Licence: CC-BY-4.0. Cost and current file access are unverified. Caveats: Workshop evaluation does not establish successful building performance or adoption of any renovation. The workshop documents were not opened. Simulation uses include validation evidence for renovation decision-support simulations. Related resources are listed in the same native collection; distinct release identities are preserved.
